title: Compactified direct-image towers, reduction and composition
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/(\varpi^n)$ for $n\ge1$. Use the operation datum [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. All schemes below are separated of finite type over $k$ and all morphisms are separated of finite type. At $A_n$ write $\mathcal C_{T,A_n}=D^b_{ctf}(T,A_n)$, the bounded constructible finite-Tor category; at $R,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ write $\mathcal C_{T,\Lambda}=D^b_c(T,\Lambda)$. Integral categories use completed coefficient sheaves and derived completeness with reductions in one finite cohomological interval independent of $n$; field categories use rationalization and common finite coefficient-field stages, respectively. 

Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ and choose compactifications $c=(j,\bar f)$, where $j$ is quasi-compact open, $\bar f$ proper and $f=\bar f j$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Write $F_f^c=R\bar f_*j_!$, with integral and field realizations exactly as in [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. On the finite bounded-below etale-origin domain (a chosen pullback from the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]), the canonical refinement maps between the $F_f^c$ are isomorphisms, independent of a common refinement, with identity and transitivity cocycles. Bounded constructible finite inputs admit these witnesses. These same normalized comparisons hold on integral constructible inputs with compatible finite-reduction witnesses and on their specified lattice and common-stage field presentations; they respect reduction and coefficient passage.
For $K\in D^b_c(X,R)$ put $K_n=K\otimes_R^L A_n$. The canonical reduction maps are isomorphisms
$$(Rf_*K)\otimes_R^L A_n\simeq Rf_{*,n}K_n,\qquad (Rf_!K)\otimes_R^L A_n\simeq Rf_{!,n}K_n.$$
For $A_n\to A_m$ both direct-image comparisons are isomorphisms on $\mathcal C_{X,A_n}$. For a coherent normalized DVR tower $(M_n)$ on $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ of [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower], the actual counit gives $(R\varprojlim\operatorname{Res}_nM_n)\otimes_R^L A_m\simeq M_m$; if its terms are constructible in one common finite cohomological interval, its limit is in $D^b_c(Y,R)$.
The canonical composition maps give $R(gf)_!\simeq Rg_!Rf_!$, satisfy identity and associativity, and agree with the specified completed and field composition maps. For proper $f$, the compactification with identity open factor gives the canonical identification $Rf_!\simeq Rf_*$, and under it the compact-support exchange $\operatorname{Ex}_!$ of [def-exchange-projection] is the proper base-change exchange $\operatorname{Ex}_*$. At the integral stage it identifies the strict quotient-transition tower defining compact support with the strict tower defining ordinary direct image, including transitions, and hence identifies their derived limits. Rational and common-stage passage carry that identification to the field stages.

proof.text: Finite origin and Tor reflection give bounded constructible etale witnesses with the input Tor interval.
Finite refinement is proper composition followed by the open/proper comparison, with independence, identity, transitivity and cocycle.
$A_m$ is finite over $A_n$, generated by $1$. Ordinary counit and compact-support tensor comparisons give the stipulated maps on witnessed finite-Tor inputs and their successive-reduction equations.

proof.text: Integral direct image has the asserted reductions. Operation reduction gives compact-support reduction; $d_c$ fixes the quotient transitions and projection/open normalization. Constructibility supplies the domain.
Normalized DVR effectivity gives the coherent counit and completeness. A common constructible interval for the terms identifies all reductions with that interval, exactly integral membership.
$R$ is Noetherian with finite residue; $(\varpi)$ is principal and $A_n$ finite perfect. The residue is additive torsion. Finite-type $k$-schemes are Noetherian, hence their opens quasi-compact.

Apply constant-coefficient word realization at $R,(\varpi)$. Completion equivalence and completed pushforward fix its coordinates; $d_c$ fixes the two-letter target. Word transport aligns the whole-word maps.

CBC refinement gives $C_u$; set $\rho_u=C_u^{-1}$. Cofilteredness supplies common refinements and equalizers, so the comparisons $C_{u_2}^{-1}C_{u_1}$ exist for any two compactifications. Realize by $a_2^{-1}\mathcal L(\rho_u)a_1$: the middle $a_1a_1^{-1}$ cancels in composites. Thus its identities, independence and cocycle persist. Calculus fixes finite evaluations; word units and operation reduction fix reductions and coefficient compatibility.

Finite composition preserves witnesses. CBC supplies the binary strict map and refinement compatibility; the normalized calculus and abstract staircase coherence give associativity and units. Compositor realization fixes its finite/completed normalization. Invert to obtain the stated direction. Iterate binary compatible-tower existence for a three-map staircase; finite preservation keeps its witnessed domains.

Proper finite coincidence is $Rf_*(a_X)$ at $c_0=(1_X,f)$. In the pro-etale exchange formula $p=f$ and open normalization makes $\beta=1$ under $a_X,a_{X'}$; hence $\alpha_{f'}\operatorname{Ex}_!=\operatorname{Ex}_*g^*\alpha_f$. Proper-tower realization identifies integral systems, projections and exchanges. Refinement handles other choices.

Rational transport sends components to $\eta_K\otimes1$, preserving inverses and equations. Operation reduction preserves defining units, counits and tensor maps under field extension. Compatible transformations descend by beta-conjugation at one common finite stage; enlargement preserves each equation, including proper coincidence. These are the specified field presentations.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q141-d08d5fd96 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Third Q141 delivery. It repairs all three faults of the 7fe34bc3 RETURN. (1) The strict-refinement node is dropped. Step 8 cites lem-cbc-complete-proetale-refinement-exchange-coherence (B=R, rho_u=C_u^-1) and does the L-conjugation. (2) strict-compositor is narrowed to: finite evaluation of D_T = alpha_{g,f}, the completed realization a^-1 L(D_T) a with one vertex map per concatenation, and the realized associativity, units and independence. Invertibility and refinement compatibility of D_T are delegated to composition-pasting-coherence; I checked that the notation and the witnessed domain match. (3) The finite pro-etale Ex_!=Ex_* argument is restored in step 10. lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization makes j'^*beta the identity after the unit identifications and agrees with the beta of def-exchange-projection, so beta=1 at j=1_X. proper-tower-exchange now cites proper-image-tower (j=1_X) and strict-tower-realization; its witness stmt_dep is now used. No argument of the 18 old steps was dropped: old 1-6, 8, 9, 15 and 18 are cited steps; old 10 and 12-13 are existing reviewed nodes; old 14, 16-17 and the U-transport are three new nodes of comparable size. The statement and stmt_deps are unchanged, proof_deps equals the union of uses, there is no cycle and no SGA citation. Step 9's use of lem-sp-compactification-refinement-coherence holds on the witnessed full subcategory: it is closed under P and J; gamma_Q is invertible for every proper/open square because s=(k,r) is clopen; the pasting laws are those of the CBC calculus; three-map staircases come from iterating compatible-tower plus cofiltered. I accept it and lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization as generic tool uses; the CBC nodes are on route (sk-prop-sf-cbc). word-realization is identical to the version reviewed before; I re-checked q^U_VW, a^U=L(q^U)eta and the empty word. Stacks tags 0F7B/C/D/J/K, 0D6E, 0A07 and 099I and the blueprint lines 12/14/16 were checked. Batch-5: all five flagged citations are accepted. The closures reach only generic lemmas (functorial flat resolutions, exact-square pasting, regularity of the completed scalar sheaf, right-fraction dense subcategory), none of them a step of the trace formula or Poincare duality; three of the cited nodes were already cited by the base item. FIX: step 8 dropped old step 10's citation for the existence of common refinements, which refinement-exchange-coherence assumes. I added lem-cbc-compactifiable-cofiltered (already in proof_deps) and one sentence.
